dataSources.purpose: Street-level imagery. Coverage tiles are proxied via BFF. The MapillaryJS viewer is loaded only after an in-app notice is confirmed, then contacts graph.mapillary.com and fbcdn.net directly from the browser.
dataSources.dataSent: Coverage tile requests are proxied. After confirmation, direct browser requests may expose IP address, browser/device request metadata, selected image ID, and viewed location to Mapillary/Meta.
dataSources.dataReceived: Nearest image ID for viewer; vector tiles (sequence lines + image points); panoramic imagery via MapillaryJS
